scope: Pre-calibration acceptance criteria for Z09-Z11 (M2 work packages). These are recomputable definitions fixed before any result; they are not evidence that Z09, Z10 or Z11 works.

workPackages.title: 风格与批量 / style and batch
workPackages.finalCompletionEvidenceText: 显式保存项目风格，十页分类/整饰一致 (roadmap §10 Z09)

criteria.assertion: A project style artifact is explicitly saved and identified by hash before any page is produced; a run that styles pages from defaults has no bound style and fails.
criteria.recompute: Read the saved style artifact path and hash from the case manifest; assert the manifest hash equals the recomputed file hash; assert every page receipt names that style id.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Token equality: font ladder, colour and class scheme, margin set, legend layout, units, north-arrow and scale-bar style equal the saved style on every page.
criteria.recompute: For each page compare the reported token values with the saved style tokens; assert exact equality, no tolerance.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Ten-page atlas consistency: page count, page order, per-page class set, legend entry order, units and source line identical where the brief requires it.
criteria.recompute: Assert page count equals the frozen expected count; assert cross-page set equality of the listed fields.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: One data fingerprint governs the whole batch; a fingerprint change re-validates all pages inside one job rather than patching single pages.
criteria.recompute: Assert one fingerprint value in every page receipt; after a fingerprint change assert a job-level re-validation record covering all pages.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Batch budget discipline: attempts, cancellations and refusals stay in the applicable denominator and per-page candidate/preview/repair budgets are not exceeded.
criteria.recompute: Compare per-page counters against the frozen WF-001 budgets and recompute the denominator from the run log.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

workPackages.deferredScopeNote: Ten-page atlas is a defined profile, not a measured run; project-style artifact custody and the style token set still need a real saved style to bind against.

workPackages.title: 多用途重排 / multi-purpose reflow
workPackages.finalCompletionEvidenceText: 横竖/打印/论文/PPT/长图规格可验证 (roadmap §10 Z10)

criteria.assertion: Every declared media profile is separately verifiable: portrait, landscape, print A4/A3 at 300 DPI, paper, PPT 16:9, long image.
criteria.recompute: For each profile assert the deliverable exists, opens, and matches its manifest hash, size and type.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Semantic-slot completeness after reflow: no required slot of the template is dropped in any profile.
criteria.recompute: Diff the reported slot list per profile against the template slot list; assert set equality.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Numeric invariance across media: numbers, units and category labels equal across profiles at canonical decimal precision.
criteria.recompute: Extract the numeric and label sets per profile and assert exact cross-profile equality.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Typography floor under reflow: no clipped, truncated or substituted text and no rendered size below the frozen font floor inherited from comparison rules v1.
criteria.recompute: Assert each profile's reported minimum rendered text size >= the v1 floor and that every required semantic string appears intact.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Legend and source retention: legend entries, scale bar, north arrow where applicable and the source note survive in every profile, including the long-image one.
criteria.recompute: Assert presence and value equality of the listed elements per profile against the print profile reference.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Geometry may change, facts may not: reflow differences are permitted only in placement and never in class assignment, NoData handling or uncertainty meaning.
criteria.recompute: Compare class sets, NoData semantics and uncertainty method notes across profiles; assert equality and flag any change as a scientific-protection failure.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

workPackages.deferredScopeNote: The six media specifications are named by FINAL; per-specification render evidence is a future execution batch, and the PS-side media export surface depends on the PS half-zone line (D-091) which is outside this line's surface.

workPackages.title: 复杂内容保护 / complex content protection
workPackages.finalCompletionEvidenceText: 密集文字、外部修改、新版生成；细粒度合并仅经验证范围 (roadmap §10 Z11)

criteria.assertion: Dense text integrity: long mixed-language narrative and annotation blocks retain every required semantic string with no clipping after composition.
criteria.recompute: Assert the extracted string set equals the frozen expected set per page; assert no truncation flag and the font floor holds.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: External original protection: the recomputed hash of a user original or external master is identical before and after the job.
criteria.recompute: Hash the original before and after and assert equality; assert the job wrote only to a new revision path.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: New-version generation: output is produced as a new revision, never by overwriting the original artifact.
criteria.recompute: Assert the output path is a new revision directory and that any overwrite attempt is refused with the pre-existing OUTPUT_EXISTS gate.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Fine-grained merge is permitted only inside an explicitly verified scope; an unverified scope generates a new version or refuses and names the scope.
criteria.recompute: For the verified case assert the merge scope list is non-empty and stated; for the unverified case assert a refusal whose reason names the scope.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Design-intent retention under data swap: class scheme, units, legend order, source note and style binding survive while data values update.
criteria.recompute: Compare design tokens before and after the swap and assert equality; assert data values changed and both facts are disclosed in the receipt.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

criteria.assertion: Dependency-aware refresh: a data change resolves the dependency graph, re-runs only the affected chain, and reports unresolved or broken links instead of hiding them.
criteria.recompute: Assert the dependency set equals the frozen manifest for the changed root; assert broken links are counted and named in the receipt.
criteria.thresholdOrigin: D-089 pre-calibration definition; thresholds are inherited from the frozen comparison rules v1 by reference and are not restated as new values

workPackages.deferredScopeNote: Fine-grained merge remains limited to an explicitly verified scope; FINAL does not guarantee arbitrary manual-edit retention in the first version, so no criterion here claims it.
